A Curious Little Corner of Alchemy.

Crooked Cauldron

Not every potion goes to plan. That's part of the magic.

Welcome to Crooked Cauldron, a charming little alchemy shop where curious customers, mysterious ingredients and questionable experiments are all part of the daily business.

Step behind the counter and become the shop's resident alchemist. Gather unusual ingredients, toss them into your cauldron, experiment with magical combinations and stir up all sorts of wonderful concoctions.

Keep your fire burning, discover the secrets hidden within your ingredients and brew potions to satisfy the strange requests of your customers. Earn your coins, improve your shop and build a reputation as the finest potion maker around.

But remember: in alchemy, things don't always go according to plan...
